focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 针对“缺少最新基线或算力不公平（Missing Baselines / Fairness）”的补全段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 实验补全与公平性自证段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [直接响应并呈上新表 Direct Fulfilment]：Following your suggestion, we have evaluated [Requested Baselines X and Y] under identical splits and added a parameter-matched variant of our model in Table R3.
S2 [对比最新基线结果 Performance vs. New Baselines]：Across all four horizons on [Datasets], our method outperforms [New Baseline X] by an average of [9.8%] in MSE and [New Baseline Y] by [12.1%].

S3 [打消参数量/算力质疑 Parameter & FLOPs Parity Proof]：Regarding model capacity, even when we scale down our hidden dimension from $d=256$ to $d=128$ (`Ours-Small`, using 38% fewer parameters and 52% fewer FLOPs than [Baseline X]), `Ours-Small` still outperforms [Baseline X] by [7.4%].
S4 [结论锁定 Conclusion]：These results confirm that our improvements derive from inductive bias rather than increased parameter count.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Direct Fulfilment -> Margin over New Baselines -> Parameter-Reduced Variant (`Ours-Small`) Proof -> Inductive Bias Takeaway. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: We added the baseline X you asked for. Our model is 0.182 and X is 0.205, so we are still better. Also our model does not have many parameters.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 过于单薄，特别是回应参数量质疑时只口头说 does not have many parameters，远不如构造一个缩小版 `Ours-Small` 依然吊打对手有说服力。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Following your suggestion, we benchmarked against the two recent baselines (TimeMixer and FreTS) and evaluated a capacity-reduced variant of our architecture (`DyTS-Lite`) in Table R3. Across all horizons on Weather and ECL, standard DyTS-Net reduces MSE by 9.6% over TimeMixer and 13.4% over FreTS. Furthermore, to ensure strict capacity fairness, `DyTS-Lite` shrinks the hidden dimension to $d=64$—requiring 42% fewer parameters and 55% fewer FLOPs than TimeMixer—yet still outperforms TimeMixer by 6.8% in average MSE. This confirms that our gains stem from structural-scale disentanglement rather than model size.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Related Work 批判分类与 Methodology 机制阐述（BP09–BP16）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 问题形式化定义与符号约定段（Problem Formulation & Notation）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 Methodology 开篇（Section 3.1 Problem Formulation），严谨、简洁地定义输入张量、输出目标、约束条件与优化目标。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Methodology 第 3.1 节 Problem Formulation
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [任务总体形式化 Task Definition]：Consider a [System/Dataset] observed over a lookback window of length $L$, denoted as $\mathbf{X} = [x_1, \dots, x_L] \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$, where $C$ represents [Meaning].
S2 [补充条件或模态输入 Auxiliary/Condition Inputs]：At each step $t$, the system also receives [Condition/Observation] $z_t \in \mathcal{Z}$ under [Noise/Missingness/Dynamic Regime].

S3 [预测/控制目标 Objective]：Our goal is to learn a parameterized mapping $f_\theta(\cdot)$ that predicts future states $\hat{\mathbf{Y}} \in \mathbb{R}^{H \times C}$ over horizon $H$ (or action trajectory $a_{t:t+K}$).
S4 [核心分布/物理约束 Core Constraint]：Crucially, unlike standard stationary settings where $P(\mathbf{X})$ remains fixed, we address the regime where [Mathematical Constraint/Shift] varies across time.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Input Space -> Auxiliary Conditions -> Target Mapping -> Crucial Distributional Constraint. 绑定逻辑规则：L014, L011.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In this section, we define the problem. The input is X. X has length L and C channels. The output is Y. Y has length H. We want to make the error between predicted Y and true Y as small as possible.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 全是碎片化的幼稚简单句（The input is X. X has...），缺乏数学严谨性与核心科学问题界定。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Consider a multivariate time series $\mathbf{X}_{1:L} = [x_1, \dots, x_L]^\top \in \mathbb{R}^{L \times C}$ recording $C$ correlated sensors over lookback horizon $L$. Given an binary observation mask $\mathbf{M} \in \{0, 1\}^{L \times C}$ indicating irregular sensor dropouts, our objective is to learn a generative mapping $p_\theta(\mathbf{Y}_{L+1:L+H} \mid \mathbf{X}_{1:L} \odot \mathbf{M})$ over future horizon $H$. Crucially, unlike standard settings that assume time-invariant marginal distributions, we explicitly account for non-stationary regime shifts where $\mathbb{E}[x_t]$ and $\text{Cov}(x_t)$ evolve continuously between the lookback and forecasting windows.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 科研个人陈述（SoP / Research Narrative）：从时间序列/生成建模迈向具身智能的闭环叙事段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [过往研究主线凝练 Past Research Thread]：My prior research has centered on modeling non-stationary dynamics and uncertainty in high-dimensional sequential data.

S2 [代表作攻克过程与硬核成果 Concrete Achievement]：In my recent work on [Time Series / Generative Modeling], I observed that [Core Bottleneck], which led me to formulate [Method]—reducing long-horizon drift by [X%] across industrial telemetry benchmarks.

S3 [向具身智能跃迁的科学顿悟 Scientific Pivot to Embodied AI]：While passive sequence forecasting predicts how an environment evolves, physical decision-making requires closing the loop: actions actively alter future state distributions.

S4 [未来研究愿景 Future Research Agenda]：Building on my foundation in continuous-time generative modeling, my doctoral/future research aims to develop sample-efficient visuomotor world models that enable robots to adapt online to non-stationary contact dynamics.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Past Core Thread -> Concrete Method & Metric -> Intellectual Bridge (Passive Forecasting -> Active Closed-Loop Control) -> Future Embodied AI Agenda. 绑定逻辑规则：L003, L025, L029.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 包含 SoP 两大禁忌：① 童年情怀套话（Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by...）；② 盲目追热点（because it is a very hot topic），没讲清你过去的时序/生成建模背景赋予了你做具身智能什么独特优势。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: My research focuses on learning reliable representations and generative trajectories from non-stationary sequential data. While investigating multivariate industrial telemetry, I found that conventional attention mechanisms collapse when underlying system dynamics shift—motivating me to design a neural-ODE coupled spectral forecaster that reduced long-range drift by 17.4%. Yet passive sequence forecasting only observes how a system evolves; intelligent physical agents must actively intervene within that loop, where every motor command alters future state distributions. Bridging my background in non-stationary time-series modeling and fast flow-matching samplers, my future research aims to build adaptive visuomotor world models that allow embodied robots to generalize across unfamiliar contact regimes in real time.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 局限性（Limitations）的无损诚实写法：界定适用边界而非自毁贡献
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 顶会强制要求写 Limitations。高水平写法是：明确指出当前方法在什么极端假设违背下（如极端稀疏采样、毫秒级超高速碰撞）性能会受限，并立即给出造成该边界的客观算力/物理原因及可行的下一步演进路径。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: While our framework performs robustly under [Standard Regime], its accuracy/efficiency is currently bounded when [Extreme Condition]. This limitation arises because [Objective Mechanism], suggesting a promising direction in [Concrete Future Fix].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 要么写成虚假自夸（Our only limitation is that our model is too general），要么写成致命自毁（Our model fails completely on real data）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Our model has some limitations. It is too slow when there are many variables and does not work well on irregular time series.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: While our cross-variate graph module scales linearly with sequence length, its quadratic complexity with respect to channel count ($O(C^2)$) increases memory overhead when $C > 1,000$. Incorporating low-rank channel projection or sparse k-NN graph routing offers a direct path to scaling toward ultra-high-dimensional sensor arrays.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 把“慢”精确化为通道维度的 $O(C^2)$ 复杂度边界（$C > 1,000$），并顺势给出低秩投影或稀疏 k-NN 路由的建设性解法。

focal_logic_rules.category: Domain Discourse (具身智能专属论证)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 具身智能感知-决策-控制闭环与 Sim-to-Real 论证规范（Embodied AI Closed-Loop Logic）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Embodied Perception-Action Loop and Sim-to-Real Logic
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 论述具身智能（Embodied AI）与机器人策略时，严禁将其等同于静态图像识别。必须突出**闭环反馈（Closed-loop feedback）**、**分布外状态累积偏移（Covariate shift in sequential decision-making）**、**接触动力学不确定性（Contact-rich dynamics）**以及**机载实时推理延迟约束（Onboard real-time latency）**。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Unlike static perception where errors remain isolated, closed-loop manipulation compounds small action deviations into out-of-distribution states. -> To maintain stability under contact uncertainty, our policy [Mechanism].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 把机器人控制写得像普通分类任务（The robot looks at the image and outputs the right class of movement）。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: The robot sees the image from the camera and predicts the action to pick up the cup accurately.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Unlike static visual recognition where prediction errors remain isolated across samples, closed-loop robotic manipulation compounds minor trajectory deviations into unfamiliar contact states. To prevent this covariate drift during precision assembly, our visuomotor policy conditions short-horizon action chunks on real-time wrist force-torque feedback.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 鲜明对比静态视觉与闭环操作中的误差累积（covariate drift），并引出视觉-力觉多模态短视野动作块控制机制。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: We added the baseline X you asked for. Our model is 0.182 and X is 0.205, so we are still better. Also our model does not have many parameters.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L017 局限性（Limitations）的无损诚实写法：界定适用边界而非自毁贡献）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: 过于单薄，特别是回应参数量质疑时只口头说 does not have many parameters，远不如构造一个缩小版 `Ours-Small` 依然吊打对手有说服力。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

step_by_step_surgery_zh: 第一步【砍壳提主干】：删去句首 AI 修辞帽与口语词，将核心实体（≤5词）提作全句主语。
第二步【强动词替换】：将 is very bad / makes it good 替换为精准及物动词（degrades / stabilizes / decouples / reduces）。
第三步【咬合信息流】：在第二、三句句首使用 `This/Such + 汇总名词` 承接上一句宾语，形成 Given-to-New 锁链。
第四步【注入实证锚点】：补全具体评测指标、对比基线或微观工程场景，彻底消除空洞夸张。
focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Following your suggestion, we benchmarked against the two recent baselines (TimeMixer and FreTS) and evaluated a capacity-reduced variant of our architecture (`DyTS-Lite`) in Table R3. Across all horizons on Weather and ECL, standard DyTS-Net reduces MSE by 9.6% over TimeMixer and 13.4% over FreTS. Furthermore, to ensure strict capacity fairness, `DyTS-Lite` shrinks the hidden dimension to $d=64$—requiring 42% fewer parameters and 55% fewer FLOPs than TimeMixer—yet still outperforms TimeMixer by 6.8% in average MSE. This confirms that our gains stem from structural-scale disentanglement rather than model size.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: In summary, our main contributions are threefold: (1) We formalize the amplitude-stationarity trade-off in long-horizon forecasting and prove that standard instance normalization bounds peak-load recoverability. (2) We propose DyTS-Net, a hybrid architecture that couples shift-invariant spectral attention with a continuous neural ODE scale tracker. (3) We demonstrate across eight public benchmarks and industrial wind-power telemetry that DyTS-Net lowers long-range MSE by up to 17.4% while cutting inference latency nearly in half.
